reviewer: error_oracle, independent of integration-test/Window/Bridge author; author of the separate Statistics page/DTO/unit tests
scope: Complete integration test file, actual affected Window/Bridge queue and telemetry paths, and source/target/link/test registration. Related page/core/reader contracts read to check fixture expectations.

findings_closed_before_final_review.finding: syntheticOwner lacked its closing function brace before wire, making wire a nested function definition.
findings_closed_before_final_review.resolution: Root added the single missing closing brace. The final source has the two helpers as separate namespace functions.

findings_closed_before_final_review.finding: Both initial synthetic torrents were ineligible for Continue, so disabled-on-Statistics alone did not test page action gating.
findings_closed_before_final_review.resolution: Alpha explicitly has canContinue=true; the row asserts enabled before Ctrl+5, disabled and no Ctrl+R dispatch in Statistics, then enabled again after Ctrl+1.

findings_closed_before_final_review.finding: There was no direct same-page multiple-refresh coalescing regression.
findings_closed_before_final_review.resolution: The added row queues three refreshes while the first read owns busy, rejects the old/intermediate results, dispatches only the latest pending request, and asserts two total reads and the latest value.

findings_closed_before_final_review.finding: The busy close row called the action directly rather than exercising the Statistics child-focus shortcut.
findings_closed_before_final_review.resolution: It now focuses Statistics tabs and sends actual Ctrl+W, then verifies close/reopen identity, no cancellation and stale-result isolation.

checks.generated_inputs: Every actual IO row uses a fresh QTemporaryDir profile containing generated empty downloads.config, tables.config and selected BiglyBT.statistics candidates. raw() is independently readable bounded bencoding with the13 correct field names/types. There is no original Java/profile/payload read or network operation in the fixtures.
checks.synthetic_vs_actual: Synthetic request owners explicitly use real pure projection DTOs, busy=true and a queued QObject-context callback. They test Window queues/navigation, not reader IO. Separate rows use actual SessionBridge, held lease and fixed-leaf reader with generated files. Neither is presented as original-manager parity.
checks.navigation_and_identity: Tools membership, actual Ctrl+5 from a focused filter, singleton reuse/Activity default, Ctrl+1 preservation of filter/width/selection/details, busy Ctrl+W close, deferred destruction, fresh reopen and old packet rejection are substantive checks.
checks.queue_sequence: Unowned/rejected Statistics and saved-services dispatches drain reentrant pending work. Column reload waits for Statistics; actual Statistics waits for a real column save. Multiple refreshes retain only latest pending identity. The assertions match actual active-token release and busy transitions.
checks.worker_and_cancellation: Real Bridge binds the published nonzero session, rejects invalid IDs and reentrant commands while delivering a result, and retains one library snapshot. Cancellation is deterministic before queued GUI delivery: the cancel connection runs in the same direct request activation after accepted dispatch, before queued result handling. Both early worker cancellation and queued-completion suppression lead to no published statistics packet or library revision.
checks.telemetry: Only LibraryModel-admitted generation/hash/rates produce payload samples. The row verifies stale/negative rejection,600-cap, another target resetting the series, and unchanged hidden torrent selection. A separate synchronous dataChanged replacement advances the actual model generation before recording; obsolete telemetry then produces no sample.
checks.lifetime: Window deletion occurs inside the actual request emission; Bridge deletion occurs inside actual result delivery. QPointers are used after deletion instead of dereferencing the reset owners. Deferred synthetic callbacks use the Window as QObject context; no deletion row relies on the synthetic helper being a general reentrant-safe completion implementation.
checks.read_only_and_reopen: Missing, invalid all and backup reads leave library opening/model/filter/selection available and preserve generated saved bytes. Real refresh and a fresh Bridge/Window cycle read externally changed generated counters. Table saving changes only its intended file and backup; statistics never gains invented recovery files.
checks.cmake: The target is inside BIGLYBTC_DESKTOP, has AUTOMOC, Qt6::Test, desktop host/profile dependencies, strict warnings/Werror,120-second CTest deadline, offscreen platform and unit/ui/statistics/config labels. It has no test syscall wrappers or production macros. New page/core/reader source registrations provide the referenced implementations.

limitations: Counts are source-planned rows, not execution results. Root owns build and CTest evidence.
The page, raw codec and fixed reader have separate unit tests; this integration file is not credited with exhaustively reproducing their entire cap/type/format corpus.
Current global/session rates, long-term history, physical durability, full original StatsView/plugin parity and performance are not established.
Actual tab-close-button mouse activation is not tested here; the busy Statistics path is covered by actual Ctrl+W and the same closePage implementation.
Synthetic library records in IO tests deliberately establish GUI preservation context and are not claimed to be worker-owned activated transfers.
